title: Vatha Kuzhambu
description: A tangy, spicy tamarind gravy built on sun-dried vegetables and sambar powder — a bold, intensely flavoured Tamil kuzhambu that keeps well for days.

ingredients.name: Tamarind
ingredients.notes: a large lemon-sized ball, soaked and pulp extracted

steps: Mix the tamarind pulp with the water, sambar powder, turmeric, jaggery and salt in a bowl, and set aside.
Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat. Add mustard seeds and fenugreek seeds, letting them splutter.
Add the dried red chillies, crushed garlic, curry leaves and asafoetida, and sauté for 1-2 minutes until the garlic is fragrant.
Pour in the tamarind mixture and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gravy thickens and the raw tamarind smell is completely gone.
The oil should start to separate slightly at the edges when it's done. Taste and adjust salt or jaggery as needed.
Serve with steamed rice — this kuzhambu tastes even better the next day, once the flavours have had time to settle.
